redflag

AI-powered due diligence for CRE

The collaborative workbench for site investigation

get started

Save weeks
search data faster
‍
Reduce risk
check more sources

Accurate answers to every question.

Zoning

Validate land-use rights, retail usage permissions, and signage constraints while identifying the specific municipal requirements for your site.

Building Code

Identify critical compliance gaps in structural, ADA, and fire safety standards to ensure your retail build-out meets all local regulatory codes.

Permitting

Navigate the path to approval with localized data on application timelines, fees, and direct contact details for key agency officials.

National Coverage.

Get results in any city, anywhere

New Construction

From market entry to parcel diligence, Redflag helps teams identify risk early, compare opportunities, and move new sites forward with confidence.

Remodels & TI

Whether refreshing an existing asset, converting a box, or managing tenant improvements, Redflag centralizes the approvals, exceptions, and site-specific issues that slow projects down.

Rollout

For national retail programs, remodel waves, relocations, and expansion plans, Redflag gives teams portfolio-wide visibility into risk, progress, and where action is needed next.

Decision intelligence.

Edit, comment, and make decisions visible to every team.

Briefly will summarize what you care about in a single email.

Surface more red flags that impact your project

"Hey Briefly - list all the concerts in LA this week!"

🤝 Lets get started 🤝

Answers you can trust

Clear reasoning and key factors, explained.
Jump to any source, with relevant text highlighted.

Edit and Collaborate

Share with collaborators, add comments and attachments.
Never forget who made a decision or why (Email from a planner? Variance granted? Saved!)

Bring your own data

Redflag understands titles, easements, text edits to specific plans, CC&Rs, leases and more.

Acquisition teams

Identify market, parcel, and site risk earlier

Development teams

Manage pre-development and site investigation with clear visibility into zoning, access, utilities, and approvals.

Executives

See risk, velocity, and where intervention is needed across every market and project.

The Central Source of Truth.

Turn zoning, code, permitting and local process risk into one operating view available to all stakeholders.

National Coverage

Get results in any city, anywhere

The preferred data tool for AEC.

Architects

Accelerate early feasibility with clear visibility into site constraints, code considerations, and project risk.

Civil Engineers

Run faster site investigations with parcel, infrastructure, environmental, and jurisdictional insights upfront.

Permitting Professionals

Bring sharper recommendations to clients with faster answers on site viability, risk, and market fit.

<script>
  var Webflow = Webflow || [];
  Webflow.push(function() {  
    // unbind webflow form handling
    $(document).off('submit');
    $('#wf-form-Presale-Form').submit(function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const $form = $(this);
      const $submit = $('[type=submit]', $form); // Submit button of form
      const buttonText = $submit.val();
      const buttonWaitingText = $submit.attr('data-wait');
      const formMethod = $form.attr('method');
      const formAction = $form.attr('action');
      const formRedirect = $form.attr('data-redirect');
      const recaptchaResponse = grecaptcha.getResponse();
      if (!recaptchaResponse) {
        alert('Please complete the reCAPTCHA challenge.');
        return;
      }
      const formData = $form.serialize();
      if (buttonWaitingText) {
        $submit.val(buttonWaitingText); 
      }
  		const username = 'BT0PdhySImxd0DoABMIkTMtE';
  		const password = 'kvQGZm8JBs3GSKPw2LNLmdFpMrZtVVf7D7';
  		const auth = btoa(`${username}:${password}`);
      $.ajax(formAction, {
      	headers: {'Authorization': `Basic ${auth}`,
    		},
        data: formData,
        method: formMethod
      })
      .done((res) => {
        // If form redirect setting set, then use this and prevent any other actions
        if (formRedirect) { window.location = formRedirect; return; }
        $form
          .hide()
          .siblings('.w-form-done').show()
          .siblings('.w-form-fail').hide();
      })
      .fail((res) => {
        $form
          .siblings('.w-form-done').hide()
          .siblings('.w-form-fail').show();
      })
      .always(() => {
        // Reset text
        $submit.val(buttonText);
      });
    });
  });
</script>
